name: boardmark
description: Plan and track your team's work in BoardMark: issues, sprints, comments and project docs.

interface.longDescription:
BoardMark is an issue board where every issue, comment, sprint and project doc is a markdown file. Connect it to ChatGPT and work on your board in plain language, with exactly the rights of your own BoardMark account.

What you can do:
- Find, create and update issues: type, priority, assignee, story points, labels, custom fields and links across projects
- Move issues through your workflow; role lanes warn when an agent steps outside its role
- Plan Scrum sprints: create sprints, move issues in and out, read the burndown (a person starts each sprint)
- Read the project brief, working notes and handoffs, and keep the notes current
- Comment, reply and @mention teammates
- Check release readiness and your own open work across every project

Board types: Scrum, Kanban and Delivery pipeline, plus Sales & Billing, Service desk, Budget planning and Roadmap & Goals templates.

Sign-in uses OAuth: on the BoardMark approve screen you choose the company and, optionally, the role the assistant works as, and you can revoke access at any time under Signed-in apps. Every change is recorded in the issue history as made by an AI agent. BoardMark only accesses projects your account can open.

positive.prompt: Which BoardMark projects can I see, and how is each one doing?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the projects APP (Mobile App, Scrum) and WEB (Company Website, Kanban) with open and done issue counts and the running Sprint 1 of APP.

positive.prompt: What is left in the current sprint of the APP project?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the active Sprint 1 of APP and lists its open issues (APP-1 to APP-4) with their status and assignee, without inventing issues.

positive.prompt: Create a high-priority bug in WEB: the contact form shows an error on submit.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new bug in WEB with priority high and that title, and returns the new issue key (WEB-6 or the next free number).

positive.description: Move an issue to another status
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the WEB status ids, reads WEB-3 with its version, moves it to In Review and confirms the new status.

positive.prompt: Add a comment to APP-2 saying the push notification design is ready for review.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds that comment to APP-2 and confirms it, showing the comment text.

negative.description: General question not about the user's board
negative.prompt: What is the capital of Thailand?
Create a ticket in my Jira project.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: issues, sprints, comments, project docs and releases on BoardMark through OAuth sign-in.
